SpaceX's Starshield: A Military Version of Starlink

SpaceX has developed Starshield, a militarized version of its Starlink satellite internet service. While sharing underlying satellite technology with Starlink, Starshield is designed for secure communications and can also provide Earth observation capabilities and integrate sensors or other payloads. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has stated that the two systems are separate.
